Defect Title: Password Reset Link Fails with 500 Internal Error
Description: Clicking password reset link in email results in unhandled null pointer exception on token verification.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to /forgot-password\n2. Enter registered email\n3. Click link received in email
Expected Result: User is directed to set new password form
Actual Result: Server returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error

Defect Title: Checkout Button Unresponsive on Safari iOS 17
Description: When clicking 'Place Order' on Mobile Safari, the button stays in loading spinner without submitting payload.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open store on iPhone Safari\n2. Add item to cart\n3. Click Place Order
Actual Result: Button spins indefinitely with console error: ApplePaySession not defined

Defect Title: Rider Map Coordinates Drift in Background Tabs
Description: When browser tab is backgrounded for 2+ minutes, WebSocket queue causes map marker to teleport.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open live delivery tracking page\n2. Switch to another tab for 2 minutes\n3. Switch back to tracking tab

Defect Title: Invoice PDF Currency Symbol Rendered as Question Mark
Description: Special character encoding issue causing KES / EUR currency symbol to render as '?' in PDF header.
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Complete order in KES currency\n2. Download generated PDF invoice
